name: QWEN-LOW-RELEASE-0
note: Machine-readable form of PRE-REG QWEN-LOW-RELEASE-0; the prose governs on any conflict. Artin's conditional GO QWEN-LOW-RELEASE-0 (2026-10-23): the chat default moves to enable_thinking True, reasoning_effort low, 768 tokens ONLY if both gates pass. Quality gate (bars 1 to 5): the fresh v3 confirmation collection (scratch/evalsets/qwen_battery_v3.json, 60 tasks in new families, frozen before any candidate output) scored once per arm under A (no thinking, 384), B (no thinking, 768, the equal-budget control) and C (thinking, low, 768, the candidate); the bars compare C with B on paired task outcomes. Reliability gate (bars 6 to 9): four eight-turn conversations (the exposed travel transcript and three new ones) under C's configuration at 768 tokens, every turn checked for addressing the request, no persistent empty completions. Decision rule: all nine bars FIRE promotes the default (booked as a separate release verdict); any other reading HOLDS the current defaults with the failing evidence named; no other budget or effort is searched in this round. Conclusions conditional on greedy decoding; a 60-task set supports a deployment smoke decision, not a general claim. The structured refuted_if_predicate encodes bar 1 only; the prose decision rule (all nine FIRE) governs, and the adjudication text is read against it.

A.description: no thinking, 384 tokens per turn: the historical practical baseline configuration, on v3

B.description: no thinking, 768 tokens per turn: the equal-budget control, on v3

C.description: enable_thinking True, reasoning_effort low, 768 tokens per turn: the promotion candidate, on v3; scored on the final answer after the last </think> (the amended thinking scorer)

CHAT-NOTHINK.description: the four conversations under enable_thinking False at 768 tokens, incremental sessions (comparison)

CHAT-LOW.description: the four conversations under enable_thinking True, reasoning_effort low, 768 tokens, incremental sessions plus a replay session for token equality (the gate)

bars.name: ARITH-JSON-GAIN
bars.description: C passes at least 5 more of the 24 arithmetic and structured-data tasks than B (the equal-budget no-thinking control); A is reported alongside.

bars.name: CODE-LOSS
bars.description: C loses at most 1 of the 12 coding passes against B.

bars.name: OTHER-LOSS
bars.description: C loses at most 1 of the 24 instruction, two-turn and termination passes against B (no material regression).

bars.name: TERMINATION
bars.description: at most 4 of C's 68 turns leave the think block unclosed, and no single kind holds more than 2 of them (no systematic concentration).

bars.name: COST
bars.description: C generates at most 14,000 tokens over the 68 turns and spends at most 1,700 s (the registered practical limit; v2 low ran 153 tokens per turn); the ratios against A and B are reported.

bars.name: NO-COLLAPSE
bars.description: no conversation under low has two or more consecutive empty completions (an empty final answer after the think block, or no final answer).

bars.name: ADDRESSED
bars.description: at least 28 of the 32 turns under low pass their registered addressing check (a required word, number or pattern, a line, word or sentence count, an exact phrase, a yes-or-no); 27 or fewer holds.

bars.name: TRAVEL-REGRESSION
bars.description: the exposed travel transcript produces no empty completion under low (it produced three under no-thinking at 48 to 96-token budgets).

bars.name: CHAT-ACCOUNTING
bars.description: every later turn under low that follows a CLOSED turn reused the cache (the pinned template re-renders an unclosed turn with a close the model never emitted, so the turn after a budget cut falls back by design and is reported apart), and the incremental session's generated ids equal the replay session's on all 32 turns.

operands.name: the validators and the thinking scorer

refuted_if: The promotion is HELD if any of the nine bars reads other than FIRE; the quality gate fails on bars 1 to 5 and the reliability gate on bars 6 to 9; the failing bar and its measured value are the HOLD's evidence. No other budget or effort is tried in this round.
registered_prior: On v2 low gained 7 arithmetic and JSON passes over the no-thinking baseline at 384 (15 against 8), kept code at 7 of 8, left 2 of 52 blocks unclosed and spent 153 tokens per turn. On fresh families the gain is expected smaller but above the bar (5 to 9 of 24), with the caveat that bar 1 needs headroom: if B already passes 20 or more of 24 the bar cannot fire however good C is; code within one of B (B expected 9 to 11 of 12 at 768 tokens; C 8 to 11), the other kinds within one of B, unterminated 1 to 4 (the two-turn and code kinds likeliest), tokens 9,000 to 12,000 and time 1,100 to 1,500 s. B against A: 768 tokens is expected to recover the one or two no-thinking replies the 384 budget cut and change nothing else (identical greedy prefixes). Reliability: low closed its block on 50 of 52 v2 battery turns; no low-effort conversation has been run before this (the earlier reuse evidence, 24 of 24, was thinking-off, and the earlier thinking conversation ran at the template's default effort with a 256-token budget and was cut once); the travel transcript is expected non-empty on all eight turns under low (the shortening came with thinking off at 48 to 96-token budgets; the factual conversation's one-word turns are the designed stress), addressed on 28 to 32 of 32, no fallback after a closed turn, replay token-equal. The weakest bars are expected to be 7 (the addressing checks are strict) and 1 (fresh families, headroom). Expected outcome: a FIRE on all nine with bar 1 or bar 7 the likeliest HOLD. Every fence is a rounding fence, not a noise fence: one greedy pass per arm on 60 tasks is a deployment smoke decision at the lab's single-seed floor.
